message: One night later, the next day.

name: Iori
message: 「Morning, everyone！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, good morni~ng!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mornin'~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, good morning.」
In the classroom, every single student of Takamura Class sat lined up, not a soul missing.
It was a sight I hadn't seen since greeting everyone on the first day.
Uh-oh, I actually felt tears welling up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei, what's wrong？」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, it's just... I'm so happy to see everyone all together in the classroom...」

name: Iori
message: 「Even Keisetsu really showed up, huh.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I am from a samurai family as well. I keep the promises I make.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I suppose this settles things for the time being. I look forward to seeing what you're capable of from here on.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I'll do my best not to disappoint you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, everyone, with this we can finally start your training！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Awesome! Sensei, hurry up and make me stronger!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hold on, I am the one receiving instruction first.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry to keep you two waiting.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's give it our best together too, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A~h, no thanks, just leave me alone.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You're not going to take Sensei's lessons？ Didn't you make a promise with him, though？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I promised I'd attend class. That much is true.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But I never promised to receive any guidance. So that part is still up to me.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’re such a pain, Momitchi~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sounds like a tsundere, doesn’t it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-it’s not like that!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, Momimomi, hasn’t your personality changed a bit？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh~ it’s just your imagination, just your imagination~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, no, you were way more of an honor student type before, right?」
Now that I think about it, I feel like Momiji has always used polite language with her classmates until now.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, come on, everyone here knows my true colors, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「So there’s no point in keeping up the act, is there.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s a hassle, so I’ve decided to just be myself. Treat me well, Teach~」
Momiji slumped over her desk, hanging limp.

name: Iori
message: 「By any chance, is Momiji actually pretty messy？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, her room was a mess, too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, so you’re saying you’ve been playing the part of an honor student all this time？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yep. Everyone kept putting me on a pedestal, going 'Suzakuin this, Suzakuin that,' so I had no choice but to play the part of the ideal Suzakuin.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Like, seriously! Being perfectly well-behaved, kind and courteous to everyone, being perfectly attentive...」

name: Momiji
message: 「There’s no way such a picture-perfect lady actually exists!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh, she does, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「She doesn’t. That’s just a delusion.」
Everyone’s gaze turns toward Keisetsu.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I can be mischievous sometimes, too, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah—Keisetsu is filthy rich, the heiress to the Kazamine family, a genuine lady, huh~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fair enough, there is one. I take it back.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Does that mean I count as a lady under that definition too？ I do, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It won’t happen. Setsugekka isn't in that category.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Grr... I’m aware of it, but it’s annoying when Momimomi says it...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, anyway, I’ll attend class.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But Iori-sensei, I have no intention of being coached by you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why won’t you accept my coaching？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m self-reliant. I have no intention of taking on a master when I don't need one.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I am a Suzakuin, after all, even if things have gone sour.」
I see. Troublesome as she is, deep down she's still a Suzakuin.

name: Momiji
message: 「I’d like to ask you the opposite, actually: why are you so intent on making me accept your coaching, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, you are expected to become the Toujinegi, aren't you？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I will become the Toujinegi. Even without any help from you, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you won't be able to beat Victoria at this rate.」

name: Iori
message: 「I don’t want to see you experience bitter defeat at the Martial Festival without even knowing why, and I don't want to regret leaving you to your own devices.」

name: Iori
message: 「That is one of the reasons why I want you to receive my coaching.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...That’s a hard thing to hear~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Are you saying I’ll lose to Victoria？」

name: Iori
message: 「That is how I read the situation.」

name: Iori
message: 「Now, it’s Momiji’s turn. What is your reason for not wanting my coaching？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Because you’re weaker than me, Sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「There’s no point in being taught by someone weaker than myself.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, she’s saying the same thing as me~」

name: Asahi
message: 「It seems Momiji-san is underestimating Iori-sensei’s true ability.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What do you think, Sensei?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Why don't you try training all of us students in the Martial Arts Division as a way to start your coaching?」

name: Asahi
message: 「That way, Momiji-san will also be able to understand just how poor her judgment was.」

name: Iori
message: 「...Well, I suppose you're right.」
Even I didn't trust my teachers back when I was a student until I’d been beaten to a pulp.
To demand acceptance of instruction without first demonstrating one's own capability is nothing but arrogance.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then everyone go change into your Spirit-Type Armaments.」

name: Iori
message: 「We will now begin the sparring practice！！！」
